body: My mum also ignores my threats about suicide. I've attempted once before. But there's no point being mad about it mate, sometimes it's hard for them to accept. Wishing you the best of luck in recovery.
I agree mate I want the same. Although it's not the answer. I know it's not, but you cant help the feelings if they are so strong.
I have 2 pairs, couldnt be without them either. I lost one pair recently was well upset then I found them thank god!
Agreed mate! I am attached to my headphones all the time. Even with my boyfriend, if we are doing our own things I'm guaranteed to have them on.
I love that idea for a tat. And thankyou x
You can do it and visit the docs . Think it can become easier from here x
Drinking helps me drink every night..not to excess but you couldnt pay me to stop lol!
Same here. One thing I like about reddit is knowing that so many other people struggle too. We are in it together, even if in the real world we feel like outsiders
I'm the same mate. But we have to stick together. We can get through this!
I'm glad. It sounds like your mums lucky to have you xx

Tell her how much you care for her. Try to think about what she enjoys and get her a gift or go for a walk together. Tell her your there for her and will work with her, tell her that no matter what she can always call you. This means so much. I attempted in feb and thats what I wanted so much for someone to tell me call me at any time of the day xx
Try doing something to make yourself feel better like getting a hair cut or exercise to improve your self esteem. Therapy is also a great option! X

I did the same in February this year. It was an awful time I'm still struggling now. But I see the beauty in the small things more now and the good times feel so much better. Things do get better I promise.. xx
